description_en: Queries the details about a phone number binding
description_zh: 查询号码的绑定详情。获取号码绑定关系状态、分机号码、是否录音、ASR状态等信息
name: QuerySubscriptionDetail

parameters.help_en:
The key of the phone number pool. Log on to the Phone Number Protection console (https://dypls.console.aliyun.com/dypls.htm#/account) and view the key of the phone number pool on the Number Pool Management page.

This parameter is required when ProductType is left empty
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)页面获取号码池Key。

当ProductType为空时必填
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Valid values:

AXB_170
AXN_170
AXN_95
AXN_EXTENSION_REUSE



This parameter is applicable to the original key accounts of Alibaba Cloud. This parameter can be ignored for Alibaba Cloud users.

This parameter is required when PoolKey is left empty
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值：
AXB_170。
AXN_170。
AXN_95。
AXN_EXTENSION_REUSE。

适用于原阿里大于客户，阿里云用户可忽略。
当PoolKey为空时必填
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The binding ID.

Log on to the Phone Number Protection console, choose Number and Number Pool > Number Management. On the Number Management page, select the desired record and click Details to view the binding ID. Alternatively, you can view the value of the SubsId parameter returned by an API operation for a phone number binding such as https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110248.html. The value of this parameter indicates a binding ID
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系ID。

请登录号码隐私保护控制台，在号码管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list)页面筛选号码，点击详情查看号码的绑定关系ID，或者在调用BindAxb (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a807e38uud6C5)等号码绑定API时查看返回参数中的SubsId。

在填写绑定关系ID时，注意填写与PhoneNoX参数关联的绑定关系ID
parameters.name: subs_id

parameters.help_en: The private number in the binding, that is, phone number X
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系中的隐私号码，即X号码。

请登录号码隐私保护控制台，在号码管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list)页面获取X号码，或者在调用BindAxb (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a807e38uud6C5)等号码绑定接口时查看返回参数中的SecretNo。

在填写X号码时，注意填写与SubsId参数关联的X号码
parameters.name: phone_nox

Code.description_en:
The response code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful.
Other status codes indicate that the request failed. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

SecretBindDetailDTO.description_en: The information returned after the QuerySubscriptionDetail operation was called
SecretBindDetailDTO.description_zh: 接口调用成功后返回的结构体

ASRModelId.description_en: The ID of the ASR model
ASRModelId.description_zh:
ASR模型ID。取值：

通用-电话-中文普通话模型 ID：7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

通用-电话-中文粤语模型 ID：9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

通用-电话-地方口音模型 ID：3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b

ASRStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic speech recognition (ASR) is enabled. Valid values:

false: ASR is disabled.
true: ASR is enabled
ASRStatus.description_zh:
ASR状态。取值：

false：关闭
true：开启

CallRestrict.description_en:
The status of one-way call restrictions. No value is returned for this parameter if one-way call restrictions are not set. Valid values:

CONTROL_AX_DISABLE: Phone number A cannot be used to call phone number X.
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE: Phone number B cannot be used to call phone number X
CallRestrict.description_zh:
单通呼叫限制的状态。如果没有设置单通呼叫限制，则不返回该参数。取值：
CONTROL_AX_DISABLE：A号码无法呼叫X号码。
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE：B号码无法呼叫X号码

ExpireDate.description_en: The expiration time of the binding

Extension.description_en: The extension in the AXG extension binding

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the binding

GroupId.description_en: The ID of number group G in the binding
GroupId.description_zh: 绑定关系中的G号码组ID，即GID

NeedRecord.description_en:
Indicates whether all calls made by the bound phone numbers are recorded. Valid values:

false
true
NeedRecord.description_zh:
是否对该绑定关系产生的所有通话，进行通话录音。取值：
false：不录音
true：录音

PhoneNoA.description_en: Phone number A in the binding

PhoneNoB.description_en: Phone number B in the binding

PhoneNoX.description_en: The private number in the binding, that is, phone number X
PhoneNoX.description_zh: 绑定关系中的隐私号码，即X号码

Status.description_en:
The binding status. Valid values:

0: The binding expired.
1: The binding is in effect
Status.description_zh:
该绑定关系的状态。取值：
0：已失效。
1：生效中
